import ctypes
from ctypes import c_uint, c_double

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define Python wrappers for the C functions
gsl.gsl_cdf_negative_binomial_P.argtypes = [c_uint, c_double, c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_negative_binomial_P.restype = c_double

gsl.gsl_cdf_negative_binomial_Q.argtypes = [c_uint, c_double, c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_negative_binomial_Q.restype = c_double

def negative_binomial_cdf_P(k, p, n):
    """Compute the CDF of the negative binomial distribution."""
    if not (0 <= p <= 1):
        raise ValueError("p must be between 0 and 1.")
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be non-negative.")
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_negative_binomial_P(k, p, n)

def negative_binomial_cdf_Q(k, p, n):
    """Compute the complementary CDF of the negative binomial distribution."""
    if not (0 <= p <= 1):
        raise ValueError("p must be between 0 and 1.")
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be non-negative.")
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_negative_binomial_Q(k, p, n)

def assert_test():
    """Test cases to validate the implementation."""
    # Test case 1: Valid inputs
    k, p, n = 5, 0.5, 10
    result_P = negative_binomial_cdf_P(k, p, n)
    result_Q = negative_binomial_cdf_Q(k, p, n)
    assert abs(result_P + result_Q - 1.0) < 1e-9, "CDF and complementary CDF do not sum to 1."

    # Test case 2: Edge case with p = 0
    k, p, n = 5, 0.0, 10
    result_P = negative_binomial_cdf_P(k, p, n)
    assert abs(result_P - 0.0) < 1e-9, "CDF with p=0 should be 0."

    # Test case 3: Edge case with p = 1
    k, p, n = 5, 1.0, 10
    result_P = negative_binomial_cdf_P(k, p, n)
    assert abs(result_P - 1.0) < 1e-9, "CDF with p=1 should be 1."

    # Test case 4: Invalid input with p > 1
    try:
        k, p, n = 5, 1.5, 10
        negative_binomial_cdf_P(k, p, n)
        assert False, "Expected an exception for p > 1."
    except ValueError:
        pass

    # Test case 5: Invalid input with n < 0
    try:
        k, p, n = 5, 0.5, -1
        negative_binomial_cdf_P(k, p, n)
        assert False, "Expected an exception for n < 0."
    except ValueError:
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
